values.note: Two solar shower stalls: campers bring their own solar shower bag, no water in the stalls. Dump station and fresh water fill near the ranger station, open in winter too. Firewood sold in summer.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232463 (description: flush toilets and drinking water, solar shower facilities; notice: dump station near the ranger station, 'Laundry services are not available'; amenities: Vault Toilets) + https://www.nps.gov/romo/planyourvisit/camping.htm (winter: running water and restrooms in Loops A-C, vault toilets in B and E, dump station and water fill)

values.note: Open year-round: summer reservation season (2026: May 21 to noon October 19), then winter first-come camping in Loops A (sites 1-62), B, C and E from October 19. The only RMNP campground open in winter.

season.source: https://www.nps.gov/romo/planyourvisit/camping.htm ('Moraine Park Campground will transition back to winter camping for the 2026-2027 season on Monday, October 19, 2026'; 'During the winter camping season, Moraine Park Campground is the only campground open'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Summer season: reservation only on recreation.gov (no in-person booking), some sites up to 6 months ahead and some on short-term release; the reservation includes the Timed Entry + Bear Lake Road permit from 1 p.m. on arrival day. Winter season: first come, first served, paid by Scan & Pay or at an entrance station. Summer limit is 7 nights in total across all RMNP campgrounds.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232463 (description and notices: reservation only in summer, 7-night limit, timed entry) + https://www.nps.gov/romo/planyourvisit/camping.htm ('Some campsites can be reserved up to 6 months in advance, while some campsites are available on a short-term release'; winter 'first come, first served basis')

values.note: 236 bookable sites in the recreation.gov catalog (46 electric) plus 22 management sites. Vehicles over 40 ft, including tow vehicle and hitch, are not permitted; many sites are for tents or vans only, so check each site's length.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232463 (notice: 'Vehicles larger than 40-feet are not permitted ... Maximum Vehicle + Trailer Length ... = 40 ft') + RIDB campsite catalog for facility 232463

note: Rocky Mountain NP campground in Moraine Park, the Big Thompson River meadow below the high peaks. About 236 sites in five loops, 46 of them electric; rigs up to 40 ft, many sites tent- or van-sized and many not level. Flush toilets, dump station, solar shower stalls (bring your own bag). Reservation only in summer, first come first served in winter, when it is the park's only open campground. Rangers may enforce keeping RV windows closed due to bears. --Claude
